description: State Ministry of Home Affairs - Public and Bank Holidays for the year 2022
categorisation: This gazette content involves the publication of a legal order under the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971, which establishes the official Public and Bank Holidays for 2022. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and legal notices, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a government official (Chamal Rajapaksa), it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
